name: Billow
author: Erin Carter
description: A continuous sheet of cloth seen from above, billowing over moving air: two slow travelling wave-trains cross the frame at a shallow diagonal, summed with soft FBM and shaded by analytic normals so every wavefront carries a moving ridge of sheen with dark troughs between. Palette hues grade across the frame so successive crests catch subtly different colours — one unbroken shaded surface that rolls open-endedly with no loop seam.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Travel speed of the wavefronts and their riding sheen, from glassy near-calm to a steady rolling billow.

params.label: Swell wavelength
params.effect: CSS-pixel wavelength of the main swell; short gives rippling taffeta, long gives huge slow rollers.

params.label: Cross wave
params.effect: Strength of the counter-angled second wave-train, from clean parallel swells to softly interfering, dappled billows.
